name: Move Amplifier - Guard
RelatedDescription: Channels extra energy directly into the leg actuator to improve the ST's mobility, whether using pulleys or walking. It can also enhance an ST's Guard.

61235.name: Movement Enhancement I - Guard
61235.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
When performing Guard, Crit RES <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit DMG RES <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
